title: RES-D4 HD-1 OTS-Calendar Substrate Stub (Tag-70)
description: Audit-only fixture catalogue for the HD-1 OTS-Calendar substrate-preparation work. This file enumerates the fixture-frames, verifier-acceptance branches, and ENV-flag gating semantics that the Tag-70 substrate-prep work is allowed to inspect, document, and frame-test in fixture mode. It MUST NOT be interpreted as a live-OTS-calendar configuration: every endpoint marker carries 'kind: fixture' and every emit-branch is gated by an ENV-flag default-off. See docs/operations/res-d4-high-residual-mitigation-deep-dive.md §6 / §6.2 / §8.1.

upstream_anchors.tag_69_deep_dive_anchor: §3.1 HD-1 mitigation strategy, §6 OTS-substrate-prep, §6.1 AR-authorisation request template (sketch only)

fixture_frames.name: registry-pointer-frame--pending-anchor
fixture_frames.purpose: Validate the producer-side frame shape when the OTS-calendar resolver returns no anchor yet. The verifier must accept this frame in audit-only mode and reject it in live-emit mode.

fixture_frames.name: registry-pointer-frame--anchor-fixture-stub
fixture_frames.purpose: Validate frame-shape with a populated stub anchor field that DOES NOT correspond to any real OTS calendar. The 'fixture://' scheme is reserved for audit-only frames and the verifier rejects it in live-emit mode.

fixture_frames.name: registry-pointer-frame--live-emit-forbidden
fixture_frames.purpose: Negative-control frame: a frame asking the verifier to switch to live-emit while the ENV-flag is off. The verifier must reject this frame with a clear 'sandbox-boundary' diagnostic.

verifier_acceptance_rules.rule: audit-only branch accepts anchor-status in {pending, stub}
live-emit branch is gated by ENV-flag WAKIR_OTS_LIVE_EMIT=1
fixture:// scheme is reserved for audit-only and rejected in live-emit

env_flag_inventory.name: WAKIR_OTS_LIVE_EMIT
env_flag_inventory.semantics: When unset or '0', verifier operates in audit-only mode and rejects every frame whose anchor-status is not in {pending, stub}. When '1', verifier enters live-emit mode and rejects every frame whose anchor-status is 'pending' or whose scheme is 'fixture://'. Switching to '1' requires AR-authorisation per §6.1 sketch and is out-of-scope for Tag-70.

env_flag_inventory.name: WAKIR_OTS_CALENDAR_URL
env_flag_inventory.semantics: Audit-only default points at the invalid 'fixture://' scheme so any accidental resolver-call fails closed. Production URL is NOT enumerated in this stub.

what_this_stub_is_not: Not a recommendation to lift the RES-D4 indefinite-deferral default.
